translations.home.headline: Book meeting rooms, desks and equipment {$START_TAG_SPAN}in seconds{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}.
translations.home.lead: See what’s free, reserve it, and watch the office calendar update live. SmartDesk makes sure no two people ever get the same slot.
translations.home.featuresTitle: Everything the office shares, in one place
translations.home.demoText: Only in this development build. Every account uses the password {$START_TAG_CODE}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_CODE}.
translations.home.ctaText: Rooms, desks, cars and equipment - the whole office, one calendar.
translations.home.feature.free.title: Find what’s free
translations.home.feature.free.text: Search by time, type and capacity, and see only the resources you can book right then.
translations.home.feature.noDouble.title: No double bookings
translations.home.feature.noDouble.text: The server refuses overlapping reservations, even when two people click at the same moment.
translations.home.feature.live.title: A live office calendar
translations.home.feature.live.text: New bookings and cancellations appear on everyone’s screen straight away, without a reload.
translations.home.feature.reminders.title: Reminders
translations.home.feature.reminders.text: Pick 5 to 60 minutes before a reservation starts and get a nudge in the app or on your desktop.
translations.home.feature.day.title: Your day at a glance
translations.home.feature.day.text: The dashboard shows today’s bookings, what’s in use right now and your next reservations.
translations.home.feature.admin.title: Tools for admins
translations.home.feature.admin.text: Manage resources, block maintenance windows, handle anyone’s bookings and read usage reports.
